visdrone2019-vid
	

Part of the VisDrone Benchmark Dataset collection.
VisDrone is a premier drone-based computer vision benchmark collected by the AISKYEYE team at Tianjin University, covering diverse urban, suburban, and rural drone scenarios with rich bounding box and trajectory annotations.
